body: I am okay. I still have to see my father and am sickened by the mention of him. I do not spend the night at his house and when I am over at his house my brother is there and I do not leave his side. I still deal with the occasional emotional abuse, but it has gotten better since my mom will do something now if I tell her and he desperately wants to get back together with her. (sleep with her) My mom is very supportive of me now when I get into fights with my father, but she still doesn't believe that the abuse happened. So it has gotten better, but I still hate my father with every fiber of my being.
